snippet.title: Minecraft Speedrun: Myriad Caves - 36:51,257
snippet.description:
Why haven't I uploaded anything in two months? Here's your answer.

»Ran in Minecraft version 1.9.4 with Optifine on Hard difficulty.

»Download the map and any other maps made by renderXR here: https://www.minecraftforum.net/forums/mapping-and-modding-java-edition/maps/2295375-ctm-collection-renderxrs-untold-stories-series

»Other Runs of this Map:

•Segmented any% WR by Ty: https://youtu.be/eqq0mijn4Fk

•Segmented any% by Leo: https://youtu.be/5sm2fXMJ2gw

•100% WR by elecsat: https://youtu.be/vk95uAPueRs

»Links to music in the order of appearance:

• 0:00 Ori and the Blind Forest - Definitive Edition Trailer -https://youtu.be/YOIeIlOj68Y

• 1:39 Ori and the Blind Forest - Breaking Through the Trap - https://youtu.be/yVCu9qp4yVc

• 2:36 Blue Wolfe Music - Seismic Shift - https://youtu.be/zdZ2I9_mQJU

• 4:28 Ori and the Blind Forest - Fleeing Kuro (Alternative) - https://youtu.be/sBFEnSAnl-E 

•6:30 E.S. Posthumus - Krosah - https://youtu.be/YUAULf3b8i0 

• 10:52 Evan King - Overwatch - https://youtu.be/mJAjzCKcp1w

• 15:00 E.S. Posthumus - Anumati - https://youtu.be/Pi3bg7W59wc

•18:23 E.S. Posthumus - Kalki - https://youtu.be/-tjt2EZA_Yg

• 21:29 Half Life 2 - Dark Energy - https://youtu.be/yAd_yjIJmYM

• 22:58 Alex Hull - Destiny 2 Orchestral Cover - https://youtu.be/BRV3N8mW5ns

• 25:42 Rumble Head - Voyage - https://youtu.be/h54xuVHaAgY

• 27:37 Pirate101 - Marleybone Armada Combat Theme - https://youtu.be/60LQzMuRRfs

•29:53 Narukami12 - In the Final Remix - https://youtu.be/LbsOEO0_WcA 

•35:36 Axl Rosenberg - Ascendance - https://youtu.be/_3sHLVtLe5U

Yes I know about forgetting to put yellow wool in the counter at the end, whoopsie.
